load_coco_retrieval_dataset: load COCO retrieval dataset annotations from a JSON file into a structured data list
build_coco_retrieval_for_training: build a COCORetrieval dataset instance in training mode to get matched image-text pairs
build_coco_retrieval_for_evaluation: build a COCORetrieval dataset instance in test mode to get image-level evaluation data
review_load_data_list: review the COCORetrieval load_data_list method that maps image IDs to filenames and builds train or eval lists
refactor_coco_retrieval_annotation_parsi: refactor the COCORetrieval class to customize how caption annotations are parsed and stored
